dataTagRelations.description: The data tags related to this type.

directDataTags.description: The direct data tags calculated on this type.

dataTags.description:
All the data tags for this type based on its direct data tags and the data tags of types related to it.
Users should override this field in order to aggregate data tag names across this entity and entities that
this entity is related to such as a Facility's data tags and its Meters' data tags.

title:
Type that gets mixed into an entity type in order to be able to tag it with
{@link DataTag}s. Should be used with parametric extensions of {@link DataTag}.
